description.en: Reveals assistant replies in fading paragraph batches instead of token-by-token output, with smooth scroll-follow while streaming and a live one-line summary on reasoning blocks. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
description.zh: 以淡入的段落批次呈现助手回复，而非逐字输出；流式过程中平滑跟随滚动，思考块显示实时单行摘要，并遵循 prefers-reduced-motion。
